390.bodyText: STAMPLI VS. VIC.AI Stampli vs. Vic.ai The key differences between Stampli versus Vic.ai Stampli is built by AP experts for AP first. If you’re considering Vic.ai, ask yourself if you are willing to bet your financial accuracy on a “touchless” system that processes invoices without human oversight. Let's Talk Stampli vs. Vic.ai G2 Satisfaction Scores → 99 Stampli 39 Vic.ai Market Segment Mid-Market SMB Market Presence 72 36 Ease of Use 95% 94% Quality of Support 96% 93% Meets Requirements 92% 91% The G2 scores in this chart are from the AP Automation category officially released for Winter 2026. Companies big and small trust Stampli with $90 billion in AP spend...and counting Why choose Stampli instead of Vic.ai for Procurement & AP automation? Stampli keeps you in control Vic.ai aims for “autonomous” processing that bypasses human review, increasing the risk of incorrect coding or fraud. Stampli’s AI doesn’t need a human backstop Vic.ai requires a long implementation phase to ingest and process historical data. The system is ineffective until it has “learned” your patterns over time. Stampli ensures total audit readiness Vic.ai’s decision logic is opaque. If the AI miscodes an expense, you cannot see why it happened, leaving you without answers during an audit. Stampli resolves the complex exceptions Vic.ai struggles when invoices don’t match a standard pattern, dumping the work back on you. What should you ask Vic.ai about? If you’re comparing Stampli versus Vic.ai, here are a few questions you should ask Vic.ai. Does the AI require a "Historical Data" upload before we can start? Is the goal "Autonomy" or "Verification"? Does "Autonomy" reduce risk, or just hide it? How real-time is the PO and Receiving data? Does the integration support our custom ERP fields? How do you handle invoices that require clarification or exception resolution? Stampli is built for the way YOU run AP Least disruption No need to rework the ERP or change your AP processes Ensure control & compliance Fully configurable and auditable payment workflows Most control One place for all your communication, documentation and workflows Smartest AI Billy assists you across the entire invoice lifecycle Fastest to value Deploys in weeks, not months, with minimal user training What do Stampli customers appreciate most? “Stampli allows for us to more accurately project cash flow, which helps us provide drastically better financial guidance to our owners.” AMANDA BROWN Controller, Wenspok Companies Stampli provided an easy-to-use interface and smart AI that others couldn’t measure up to. The overall customer experience was also much more positive in comparison. ALYSSA A. Senior Accountant “Many AP automation companies have started in the payments industry and gradually expanded to AP, but Stampli started in AP. I like that Stampli was AP first.” CURTIS ASH CFO, Avid Acceptance “I’d say Stampli displaces $150K to $200K in labor expenses annually, while providing more accuracy and reducing human error.” ANTHONY FERNANDES Financial Controller, Alden Renewables “Stampli allows for us to more accurately project cash flow, which helps us provide drastically better financial guidance to our owners.” AMANDA BROWN Controller, Wenspok Companies Stampli provided an easy-to-use interface and smart AI that others couldn’t measure up to. The overall customer experience was also much more positive in comparison. ALYSSA A. Senior Accountant Stampli vs. Vic.ai for Procurement & AP automation Want to see the differences for yourself?
